## What this is

The official waitlist and demand engine for The Logo Protocol: Founding Signal — a 99-pass utility-first digital membership pilot by Cumulative Web Inc. Four classes (Origin / Vector / Phantom / Crown Signal), utility calendar, and a hard mint gate: no mint date until 75 qualified waitlist members are recorded plus four further gates (utility calendar, rights, technology, control). Every signup is a public GitHub issue with the waitlist label; the hourly demand engine counts open issues into data/demand.json. No mint, no listing, no payment — this page measures demand, not sales.

## Truth labeling

LIVE. The demand count is real: rendered from data/demand.json, counted hourly from open GitHub issues labeled waitlist. Current count 0/75 — the mint gate is CLOSED. No mint, no listing, no payment anywhere on this page; the FAQ states no payment, no wallet connection, no obligation. Nothing here enables payments.
